text: Zelensky says the US floated NATO membership for Ukraine in exchange for ceding the Donbas. The claim is Zelensky's; no US confirmation is recorded in the tracker. It follows US envoys meeting Putin in the Kremlin on 12 Nov.

judge.comment: Attributed claim of a sensitive diplomatic nature; wording keeps it as Zelensky's assertion. Human check advised before publishing.
